series.title: Canadian Solar’s e-STORAGE to deliver 200MWh BESS for Australian solar-plus-storage site
series.summary: e-STORAGE has signed an agreement to supply and commission a 100MW/200MWh BESS for OX2's Muswellbrook solar-plus-storage site in Australia.

series.title: EDF Power Solutions Australia refers 800MWh wind-plus-storage site to EPBC Act
series.summary: EDF Power Solutions Australia has referred a wind-plus-storage project featuring an 800MWh BESS for assessment under Australia's EPBC Act.

series.title: Dutch BESS developer Giga Storage brings gigawatt-hour-scale project strategy to Germany
series.summary: Having just begun construction on a 2.8GWh BESS in Belgium, Giga Storage has progressed its 1.4GWh project in Germany to the ready-to-build stage.

series.title: BW ESS starts building 828MWh BESS in Italy as ‘market moves to execution’
series.summary: BESS owner-operator BW ESS has launched construction on its second large-scale project in Italy in the space of a month, while developers Galileo and Aura Power have progressed portfolios in the country.

series.title: NextEra halts Long Island BESS operations over drinking water contamination concerns
series.summary: US energy holding company and project developer-owner NextEra Energy has suspended operations at two energy storage facilities in Long Island, New York, US.

series.title: Australia: Eku Energy locks community deals for 2.76GWh Queensland BESS duo as Valo wins 1.6GWh contract
series.summary: Eku Energy has signed CBAs with Gladstone Regional Council and Western Downs Regional Council for two BESS projects in Queensland.

series.title: Global BESS failure rates declined 98% between 2018 and 2025
series.summary: Annual battery energy storage system (BESS) failures per-deployed-GWh declined 98% globally between 2018 and 2025, as installed BESS capacity grew exponentially.

series.title: Return puts Netherlands’ largest BESS online
series.summary: BESS owner-operator Return has put its 100MW/200MWh Antares BESS in the Netherlands into commercial operation, the largest to have reached that stage in the country as far as we know.

series.title: B2U CEO: US second-life BESS can compete with ‘China price’
series.summary: Energy-Storage.news Premium speaks with Freeman Hall, CEO of second-life BESS firm B2U Storage Solutions.

series.title: Actis buys 1.14GWh of BESS in Poland from DTEK’s DRI
series.summary: Infrastructure investor Actis has entered the Polish energy storage market with the acquisition of two large-scale projects from DTEK's DRI, while R.Power and Solax have announced project updates in the country.

series.title: 4-hour storage cheaper than gas peakers across global markets: WoodMac
series.summary: In North America, data centers are boosting the long-term investment case for energy storage and renewables as gas turbine backlogs and rising fuel volatility drive up peaking costs, according to a Thursday note from Wood Mackenzie.

series.title: Power system plans to meet large-load demand miss near-term solutions: analysts
series.summary: Major work by regional planners is focused on flexible access to existing transmission. Some say greater emphasis on advanced transmission technologies can quickly and cost-effectively create room for new large loads.

series.title: Massachusetts shifts clean energy funds to help heat homes this winter
series.summary: Gov. Maura Healey ordered home energy relief for low- and middle-income households, to be funded by alternative compliance payments — the fees electricity suppliers pay when they fall short of mandated clean energy targets.

series.title: Mint Renewables wins planning approval for 800MWh battery storage system in Western Australia
series.summary: Mint Renewables has received planning approval for an 800MWh battery energy storage system (BESS) near Kojonup in Western Australia.

series.title: IEA: Thermal energy storage key to industrial heat electrification that could cut EU gas demand by 35 bcm annually
series.summary: Electrifying low-temperature industrial heat and steam processes with renewables could reduce European Union natural gas consumption by 35 billion cubic metres-per-year, according to a report from the International Energy Agency (IEA).

series.title: Finland: BESS acquisition, construction and optimisation news from Usva Energia, Nala Renewables, Centrica and Olana Energy
series.summary: Finland is the Nordic region’s most-talked-about market for the moment, with project deals and other battery storage development activity from local and international players.

series.title: Europe’s system integrators move quickly on sodium-ion with CATL: ‘surprised if we aren’t deploying it next year’
series.summary: Intilion has just tied up with CATL for sodium-ion BESS deployments in Europe, following Alfen’s similar move in July, while Merus Power tells us it is in the process of integrating with the OEM’s new product.

series.title: South Africa pursues 4.6GW of battery storage deployments in Integrated Resource Plan

series.summary: The grid operator expects Engie’s two storage projects totaling nearly 1.7 GW and LS Power’s 455-MW   gas-fired uprate will be online by mid-2029.

series.title: Australia home battery installations surge 52% to 276,011 in H1 2026, outpacing rooftop solar growth
series.summary: Australians installed 276,011 home battery storage systems in the first half of 2026, 52% more than in the previous six months.

series.title: ASEAN Centre for Energy, IEA say Southeast Asia’s battery storage adoption barriers are mostly regulatory, not technical
series.summary: ACE and the IEA say the main obstacles to battery energy storage system (BESS) deployment in Southeast Asia are policy and market rules.

series.summary: France's energy regulator has proposed the parameters for the country's first long-term capacity auction, covering the winter of 2030-31. The auction will target 82 GW of capacity, including 3 GW eligible for multi-year contracts, as France seeks to safeguard electricity supplies while limiting costs for consumers.…
